name: WOL Forwarder
description: Wake-on-LAN (WOL) magic packets with a matching secureOn are broadcasted on your LAN.
options_description: listen_port: UDP port to receive magic packets with secureOn (usually above 50000, add-on uses host network). wol_port: broadcast destination (only when secureOn is correct). secure_on: hex string for secureOn matching. broadcast_ip: destination broadcast IP. allowed_hosts: list of allowed source IPs. dns_ttl: TTL for DNS responses. http_api_enabled: enable HTTP status API. api_port: port for HTTP API.
author: erkr
